GF_DEATH_POLICY.title: Death Insurance
GF_DEATH_POLICY.description: If you die while insured, clear Energy. Next turn revive at 1 HP, clear buffs and gain 1 extra Energy. A pending claim advances a party wipe to the next turn.
GF_WORK_POLICY.title: Workers’ Policy
GF_WORK_POLICY.description: The next enemy attack that costs you HP and leaves you alive heals you for 5. The issuer draws 1 extra next turn.
GF_ECHO_POWER.title: Same Here
GF_ECHO_POWER.description: Each turn, if the first card your partner plays after your opening card matches its type, you both gain Block.
GF_ECHO_POWER.smartDescription: Each turn, if the first card {ApplierName} plays after {OwnerName}'s opening card matches its type, both gain {Amount} Block.
GF_APPLAUSE_POWER.title: Big Spender
GF_APPLAUSE_POWER.description: Triggers on an ally actually spending 2 or more Energy on one card, once per turn.
GF_POT_POWER.title: Holding the Pot
GF_POT_POWER.description: After you play a card, the pot automatically passes to a random living teammate. If you hold it when the team ends the turn, take {Self} damage and deal {Area} damage to each enemy.
